top_signals.title: Blowout Jobs Report Jolts Markets | Open Interest 9/4/2026
top_signals.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Isabelle Lee and Michael Mckee on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Stocks fall and yields jump after a blowout jobs report. White House economic adviser Chris Phelan joins us on the labor market, inflation and rates. Plus, Anthropic moves closer to a mega IPO, OpenAI unveils its latest model, Morgan Stanley cracks down on research shared on X, and Aptera’s Co-CEO joins us on why he's betting on China to build its solar EV. (Source: Bloomberg)
